thread:
Lina P: Quick heads-up — we saw ~4% of inbound leads in the last hour fall through the handoff (no owner in HS) after enrichment lagged. Can we triage before the next webinar?
Raj S: ugh, thanks for flagging. Is this the enrichment TTL spike we saw yesterday?
Marta G: yes — enrichment job had a backlog so HubSpot workflow didn't receive the enriched payload and RB assignment rule skipped.
Devon: @Raj S I pushed a quick routing patch to staging that falls back to raw payload with a 2-min SLA for owner claim. deploy-bot: routing-patch v1.2 deployed to staging :rocket:
Raj S: Nice. Can we make the SLA explicit — want to target <=2m from lead creation to assigned owner for PLG leads. For MQLs keep 15m.
Lina P: Agreed. Also request: add a sampling flag so we can surface a list of leads older than SLA for manual review.
Marta G: putting together an Ops checklist — will include: 1) enrichment queue depth alert, 2) fallback assign toggle, 3) claim-time histogram in the dashboard.
Devon: Quick config snippet I tested in staging (HubSpot workflow condition):
```
IF enrichment_status == "missing" AND lead_age_seconds < 120 THEN route_via: round_robin_fallback
ELSE process_normally
```
Works with our existing RR token.
Raj S: Good. For Salesforce sync we should set a dedupe key so the fallback owner doesn't overwrite existing owner after enrichment arrives. Suggest using `lead_external_id` + `fallback=true` tag.
Lina P: Can you add an audit field on lead: `handoff_path: fallback|normal` so marketing ops can filter?
Marta G: Will do. Also scheduling: plan to run a smoke test tomorrow 09:30 PT during low traffic, then a limited rollout to 10% of traffic. If green, full rollout 11:00 PT.
Devon: I'll add a Grafana panel for claim latency and a heartbeat that pings leads with no owner after 30s.
ops-bot: alert created: inbound-enrichment-queue > 80% capacity -> #eng-ops. View: https://grafana.example/graph/LA1d
Raj S: Post-rollout checklist: verify HubSpot->Salesforce owner mapping, verify enrichment TTL metrics, confirm no duplicate owners.
Lina P: Thanks team — please add any additional test cases to the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketing/handoff-playbooks (I added initial template). :thumbsup:
Marta G: added test cases + edge-case for delayed enrichment (>10m). Will join smoke test.
Devon: rolling patch to canary at 09:30 PT, will ping here when done.
Lina P: perfect — ping me when canary hits, I'll run the lead claim spotcheck. :eyes:
